about: Copy to recall-questions.local.json (gitignored) and replace with real questions. q is asked as written; expect lists the memories that answer it, any one of which counts as a hit. expect: [] marks a question no memory should answer, which measures noise from the recall hook.

questions.q: How do I update the memory server after a new commit?
Which port should the reverse proxy forward to?
What will the weather be like this weekend?
